content.text: Pherus Health is a personal health system built on the idea of owning your own health. It's meant to be decentralised: your health information stays under your control, built on modern web technologies and open standards rather than a closed proprietary format.
It sits under Pherus's wider health and wellbeing work: technology and research around health, care, and better access to information.
[This project is still being defined. Full details, features, and technology choices will be published here once there's something real to show.]
